title: Bastian and the Right Snack for Ducks
youtube_title: Bastian and the Right Snack for Ducks | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Caring for nature means offering the right food and not wasting what we already have.
summary: Bastian wants to feed the ducks a bag of old bread. He learns bread is not a healthy food for ducks. He does not dump it. Good slices become toast for people, and dry ends go into the compost. He brings oats and peas instead, and the ducks eat calmly at the pond.
